description: React component for the Video Feed Page, displaying a vertical video feed with infinite scrolling, progress tracking, and a quiz modal.

methods.name: VideoFeedPage
methods.description: Main React functional component rendering the video feed page with infinite scroll and progress tracking.

methods.name: normalizeItems
methods.description: Normalizes API response data to an array of items.

methods.name: fetchPage
methods.description: Fetches a page of video feed data from the API, updates state accordingly.

methods.name: onVideoPlay
methods.description: Handles video play event, tracks 'started' status, and sets selected video.

methods.name: onVideoEnd
methods.description: Handles video end event, tracks 'completed' status, and selects next video.
